name: Session Unavailable
description: Takes the place of a window that never reached its Session, says why when the start was refused, with the same meaning and remedy as the TUI and CLI, and offers an explicit retry.

states: Inspect the generic, recovery-required, Desktop too old, Session too old (with and without its version), other environment, and development build explanations and the Try Again action in English and Simplified Chinese.

useWhen: A Server Client window could not open its Session before reading any Workbench state.
avoidWhen: The connection ended after the Workbench was shown; the Session Disconnected Status keeps that view instead.
An explicit route no longer resolves; Route Unavailable owns that explanation.
invariants: Trying again is the only effect; nothing retries or recovers automatically.
Recovering or stopping the Session stays an explicit command that the surface names but never runs.
A refused version names both the Desktop and the Session version, leaving out one the Session did not state.
The window stays movable through a title-bar strip, because no Workbench draws one.
All user-facing copy is provided by the Orchbee localization catalog.
